shortcut_comparison: 25% among the four unit-fraction choices, versus 100% before repair; 20% is blind guessing among all five choices. Base 1 can legitimately be eliminated mathematically.
limitations: Finite audit; no claim to rule out every shortcut.
Live publication requires an independent policy review.

delivery.selection_limits: Captured-inventory audit, not an actual learner draw. Selection excludes history, chooses a weighted eligible difficulty and uniformly hashes within that band; policies without weights use the first candidate. Only easy is certified here.

rendering.observations: Radical indices, fraction exponents, decimal radicands, option labels and worked solutions are legible and consistent. Counterfactual prompts visibly change the correct response.

publication_status: Staged; independent review has not been launched. Awaiting explicit authorization to launch a separate reviewer.
